coordinate_contract: Moon body-fixed latitude/longitude are transformed into each raster's declared CRS using a spherical lunar geographic CRS. Raster CRS, affine transform, unit, NoData and pixel metadata must be inspected before trusting a horizon.
notes: Add DEM assets only after download, metadata inspection, SHA-256 capture and a CRS round-trip check.
PGDA product 78 site DEMs are 5 m/pixel GeoTIFFs using south-polar stereographic X/Y in MOON_ME referenced to DE421; they have high interpolated-cell fractions, which are not the same as accuracy.
PGDA product 90 provides regional multi-resolution COG DEMs. Quantitative reads must use full-resolution raster data, not overview pyramid levels.
PGDA product 69 long-term average illumination products are sanity-check overlays only, not time-specific event truth.
